facts.anchor: That was a warning. It will be back.

facts.fact: 他戴呢帽出门以限制视野
facts.anchor: He left the house in a tweed cap to restrict his vision

facts.fact: 他曾亲眼看见数百只死鸟与网球
facts.anchor: There were hundreds of them there. He’d seen them.

facts.fact: 其中一只落下时砸中了他
facts.anchor: One had struck him as it fell.

facts.fact: 他自我说服世上没有 Barguest
facts.anchor: There was no such thing as the Barguest

facts.fact: 扔掉手机前的最后一条短信「我知道你做了什么」
